title: How to Cultivate Fruits in Drums or Boxes on the Roof?

title: How to Protect Guava Fruits from Fruit Borer in Rooftop Gardens?

title: What Are the Rules for Caring for Sweet Pumpkin Plants in a Rooftop Garden?
content: Keep the soil around the plant base moist without allowing water stagnation. Apply liquid organic fertilizer such as cow dung soaked water or vermicompost tea every 10-15 days. title: What Are the Special Tips for Cultivating Sweet Pumpkins in a Rooftop Garden?

title: What Is the Biggest Risk to Rooftop Gardening During the Monsoon?

title: What If Fruit Trees Are Late in Bearing Fruit on the Roof?
content: Apply proper fertilizer and prune the trees to encourage timely fruiting.

title: Where Should Bell or Gourd Vines Be Grown on the Roof?
content: Bell or gourd vines should be grown using a loft or trellis for proper support.

title: How to Keep Trees Cool on a Rooftop Garden?
content: Use mulching and shade to keep trees cool on the rooftop.

title: What to Do If Trees Grow Too Big on the Roof?
content: Pruning is necessary if trees grow too big on the rooftop garden.

title: How to Dry the Roof When Wet?
content: Open the roof drains and allow the roof to dry in the sun.

title: What to Do If the Rooftop Garden Becomes Messy?
content: Rearrange the plants and beds according to the garden design.

title: How Long Does It Take to Harvest Vegetables on the Roof?
content: Vegetables take 30-90 days to harvest depending on the type.

title: Can Fish Be Grown on the Roof?
content: Yes, fish can be grown on the roof, but safety must be ensured.

title: Can Bees Be Kept on the Roof?
content: Small beehives can be kept on the rooftop for pollination.

title: Which Plants Are Suitable for Low Sunlight on the Roof?
content: Plants like moneyplant, peace lily, and coleus are suitable for low sunlight areas on the roof.

title: Is a Rooftop Garden Safe for Children?
content: A rooftop garden is safe for children if proper protection is provided at the edges.

title: Can Grass Be Planted on the Roof?
content: Grass can be planted on the roof, but it needs regular cutting and maintenance.

title: Can Flowers and Vegetables Be Planted Together on the Roof?
content: Yes, planting flowers and vegetables together on the roof is very effective as companion planting.

title: Can a Roof Garden Be Started on a Low Budget?
content: A small-scale roof garden can be started with a budget of 2,000-3,000 taka.

title: What Is the Most Important Rule of a Roof Garden?
content: The most important rule of a roof garden is to ensure proper water, light, soil, and drainage.
